objective: Retain a bounded, scalar-only metric projection per history entry so an alert can be explained from the history endpoint rather than only counted.
decision_supported: Is an alert count enough to review an alert? No: the reviewer needs the values that produced the verdict, and the bounded history could not reconstruct them.
acceptance: Each history entry carries the metric name, value, unit, state and source.
Retained detail is bounded per domain.
Only scalars are retained, so the record cannot grow without bound.
stop_conditions: The change would need a control or alert-clear path.
risks_and_fallbacks: Retaining values enlarges each history entry; the per-domain ceiling keeps it bounded and the snapshot count is unchanged.
